Q1: Where should the fix to `EXPECTED_STEP_DECLARATIONS["plan.yml"]` (five → six, plus the updated count comment) land?
Choices:
A) On PR #7229's head branch `ai/issue-7216`, by adding a `Target branch: ai/issue-7216` line to this issue. The test change then ships with the step that needs it. (RECOMMENDED)
B) Nowhere through this issue. Close it and let PR #7229's own review/autofix loop update the test, since the failure only exists on that PR.
C) On the default branch. **Note:** the default branch's `plan.yml` has only five declarations, so this would make CI fail on `main` until PR #7229 merges. Pick this only if the two changes will merge together.
